EVALUATION_HELD: per the frozen protocol the cohort is NOT evaluated before 25 COMPLETE markets unless a catastrophic gate fires
market_completeness_criterion: RUNNER-LEVEL criterion, not a frozen-spec parameter: span >= 840s of the 900s window AND no observation gap > 60s. Partially observed markets are reported but do not count toward the 25.

gate.NOTE: a breach halts collection and is reported as a measurement result. It is NEVER grounds for retuning a placement parameter and re-running.

NOT_A_CLAIM_ABOUT_L5: the 0.96 reservation is OUR pair-economics constraint, not a reproduction of L5. Running pair-cost control was REFUTED.
